title: Nassim Taleb Calls Stocks a 'Trap,' Sees 'Naive' AI Investors
text: Nassim Taleb, author of “The Black Swan” and distinguished scientist at Universa Investments, calls the stock market a "trap" and sees a class of "naive" investors who will invest in firms linked to AI during an interview with Bloomberg's Natalia Kniazhevich at the Greenwich Economic Forum. (Source: Bloomberg)
